assumptions: Owner-controlled repository and the founder's own Claude sessions on the existing subscription at EUR 0 additional spend; transcript layout is host-documented but unconfirmed until the first G0 run; SPEC-023 acceptance and analysis.py stay unchanged; SPEC-052 supplies the v1 gate; G0 is not frozen and the decision record is unsigned.
compatibility: Additive to AIM 0.2.0-draft, the analysis report and the SPEC-052 gate; declared additive dependency on SPEC-023 (ADP.1) without changing its acceptance, limits or synthetic-only default; no change to analysis.py or the plugin MCP tool set.
domain: Claude Code dynamic-workflow subagent transcripts of 3 or 4 worktree agents in one Git repository, mapped conservatively to AIM 0.2.0-draft; a transcript is a record of requested tool calls, not observed effects.
execution_contract: Read-only. No model invocation, network, grant, merge or promotion by any adapter or checker; the founder runs G0 workflows outside this delivery; implementation requirements are blocked by G0; no concurrent agent, push or remote issue is authorized.
hypotheses: H-CW1 (untested): Braid commit-level analysis or transcript read/write overlap identifies integration failures that git merge-tree misses, with precision at least 0.3 and attribution coverage of changed files at least 0.60; falsification and inconclusive outcomes are valid.
observation_contract: Run-level reference outcome from a serial Git merge in a preregistered order plus project tests; predictions hashed before the reference exists; the probe retains integer counts only; unknown, partial, excluded and inconclusive cases are reported with denominators.

scenarios.given: the G0 proposal and its inputs record
scenarios.planned_evidence: Run of the named unittest class and the structural checker with exact commands, hashes and outcomes; structural only, not a G0 result.
scenarios.then: the proposal bytes, every required field and each threshold (C1a and C1b at least 1 each, C1b with its attribution condition, C2 at least 0.3 and above both the reference-failure prevalence and the naive path-overlap precision, C3 attribution coverage of changes at least 0.60 (`5*attributed >= 3*changed`; zero changed files leaves it unmet), C4 at most 1 flagged negative control), the freeze order, the decision rule with its order of evaluation, the kill outcome, the EUR 0 budget, the probe's counts-only retention and the unfrozen, non-authorizing status are pinned, and removing or relaxing any of them is rejected
scenarios.when: the structural checker and its tests run

requirements.text: Preregister gate G0 before any data exists

scenarios.planned_evidence: Run of the named unittest class and the structural checker with exact commands, hashes and outcomes; structural only, not a G0 result.
scenarios.then: it states EUR 0 additional spend on the existing subscription, the transcript source scope and its pending provider-terms confirmation, the G0 aggregate-only retention table and a pending signature, and no approval is inferred from the draft

requirements.text: Record source rights and budget for founder signature

scenarios.given: bounded Claude subagent transcripts and a base commit
scenarios.planned_evidence: tests/test_claude_transcript_trace.py (planned, not existing) mapping-table cases and byte-identical analysis of non-Claude inputs, plus procedure_req_003; blocked until G0 is frozen, run and recorded as a pass; exact commands, hashes, failures and limits.
scenarios.then: `Read` yields a read effect, `Edit`, `Write` and `NotebookEdit` yield write effects, and `Bash`, `Grep`, `Glob`, MCP tools and every other tool yield an `unknown` effect; the mapper lives outside `agent_braid/analysis.py`, has a versioned identifier, adds no vendor field to the core schema and leaves analysis results for existing inputs unchanged

requirements.text: Map transcripts with an additive Claude mapper (BLOCKED by G0)

scenarios.given: an agent reads a path that exists at the base commit
scenarios.planned_evidence: tests/test_claude_transcript_trace.py (planned) base-blob binding and exclusion cases against a fixture Git repository, plus procedure_req_004; blocked until G0 passes; exact commands, hashes, failures and limits.
scenarios.then: the read is bound to the base blob identity (the integer representation and its provenance table are fixed at planning); a read of a path the same agent already wrote, a path absent at the base, or a path outside the worktree emits no read effect and no read version and is counted as a recorded loss (an AIM read effect without a version is itself reported as a loss by the generic importer, so none is emitted)

requirements.text: Bind reads to the base blob and ignore self-reads (BLOCKED by G0)

scenarios.planned_evidence: tests/test_claude_transcript_trace.py (planned) coverage, failed-call and inferred-channel cases and the probe conformance report, plus procedure_req_005; blocked until G0 passes; exact commands, hashes, failures and limits.
scenarios.then: it is always `partial` (never `complete`), failed tool calls produce no effect and count as losses, and no pair containing an `unknown` effect is reported as an independent candidate with complete coverage; because coverage is always `partial`, a transcript-derived pair can be classified only as `conflicting`, `ordered` or `unknown`, never as an independent candidate, so transcript evidence can surface hazards but never positive independence; transcript-derived effects are recorded in the `inferred` channel because they are the agent's recorded request, not an independently observed effect

requirements.text: Keep coverage partial and never promote unknown (BLOCKED by G0)

requirements.text: Admit real transcripts only through a reviewed path (BLOCKED by G0)

scenarios.given: transcripts that contain prompts, file contents, command output and secret-like strings
scenarios.planned_evidence: tests/test_claude_transcript_trace.py (planned) bounds, sentinel and no-network cases and the independent privacy and security review record, plus procedure_req_007; blocked until G0 passes; exact commands, hashes, failures and limits.
scenarios.then: the converter reads locally and without network, streams within fail-closed bounds (confirmed at clarification on 2026-10-23: at most 32 transcripts, 32 MiB per transcript, 1 MiB per line, 512 distinct paths per agent, metadata strings of at most 256 characters), retains and emits only allowlisted metadata and aggregate counts under the retention label `allowlisted-metadata-and-counts` (not `aggregate-only`, which is the G0 probe's stricter rule), names the retained non-aggregate items (repository-relative paths, base object ids and a per-transcript SHA-256 digest) in the admission record as sensitive metadata, never copies prompts, file contents, command text or tool output into a result, provenance or diagnostic, and rejects breaches before analysis

scenarios.planned_evidence: tests/test_claude_transcript_gate_v2.py (planned) the argument overlay tests, package verification and founder host receipts, plus procedure_req_009; blocked until G0 passes and SPEC-052's v1 gate exists; exact commands, hashes, failures and limits.
scenarios.then: a single agent converts them to AIM through the mapper by calling the bundled CLI subcommand `analyze-claude-transcripts`, used alongside the working MCP tools and not only as a fallback, under the constrained Bash that SPEC-052's Clarifications and REQ-016(d) define once (explicit launcher subcommands only, never the launcher binary) and that gate v2 extends by exactly that one additional subcommand as a planning amendment approved by the founder on 2026-10-24 (the plugin MCP tool set is unchanged and cannot read transcripts outside registered workspaces), without raising SPEC-052's bound of four agents, and a missing, unreadable, oversized or unrecognized transcript degrades only the transcript evidence, never the commit-level evidence, and is reported as such; if the host cannot express that constrained Bash, the amendment is refused or host verification HV-1 fails, the transcript part of the gate is no-go (a valid negative result) and the commit-level gate is unaffected

scenarios.planned_evidence: tests/test_claude_transcript_gate_v2.py (planned) v2 schema, overlay composition against the committed SPEC-052 v1 schema and v1-consumer tests and the migration note in contracts/gate-result-v2.md, plus procedure_req_010; blocked until G0 passes and SPEC-052's v1 gate exists; exact commands, hashes, failures and limits.

scientific_limits: No acceptance evidence obtained; designed overlap on one repository with 10 or more runs is a feasibility screen, not prevalence or effectiveness; a single hit can satisfy C1; hypothesis H-CW1 may be false or inconclusive; Bash effects are invisible; structural tests prove no semantic or scientific claim.
scope: Preregister gate G0 and specify, behind it, an additive Claude subagent transcript to AIM adapter, a reviewed real-source admission path, privacy and size bounds, and the gate v2 transcript consumption requirements for M4.6.
